## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and link the Kaneo ticket. State supported
scope and remaining limitations.

## Verification

- Risk areas and acceptance criteria:
- Tests or workflow steps run, with results and CI links:
- Platforms checked; required checks not run or blocked:
- For calculations/files: case IDs, expected-result source, comparison rules,
  and preservation/failure checks:
- For UI changes: semantic workflow evidence and relevant visual/native checks:
- Verifier and outstanding defects:

Use N/A with a reason where a category does not apply. Keep restricted
worksheets, reference outputs and binary research out of the PR.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and supported limits are clear.
- [ ] Relevant formatting, lint and test checks pass; gaps are explicit.
- [ ] Meaningful edge/failure cases and regressions are covered where needed.
- [ ] Compatibility claims match observed evidence; unverified cases stay visible.
- [ ] Numerical, file preservation and platform risks have been reviewed as applicable.

See [the QA operating plan](../docs/qa-plan.md) for completion and release gates.
